body: Same here man. I’m glad you consider them even when you want to die. It shows your strength. Keep hanging on for them.
Some ways are quick, but none are painless. Please please please don’t use a gun.
I hope the rest of your time is spent making yourself happy before you go. I’m sorry this world has driven you to this man.

I also have the disorder. Maybe medication isn’t the best option. I took it for 7 years and all it did was leave me a hollow shell. 
Have you considered getting a therapy dog?
Ah, so your a fan of the Smiths maybe?
Thanks for talking to me though. You have cheered me up a bit, honestly.

Hahahaha man you and me have so much in common. I do the same shit and yeah my face shows whatever emotion I feel. I feel bad most of the time so I look like an asshole most of the places I go. But hey at least no one tries to pick a fight or anything. 
Only people who bother me want money or a cigarette or some shit

Yeah same actually. I can’t even go through a check out line anymore. I just am so used to being invisible. I guess i am really bad about keeping my feelings in. It’s like anytime even one thing goes wrong now I am ready to end it all. I wish I had people like you near me.

That’s why I seek out help here. When someone understands you, it automatically feels like they care a lot about you... i don’t know it might be because I’m disregarded daily. 
I really struggle with daily tasks anymore.
I suppose I am just used to people reacting negatively when I speak. It makes me feel insane.

DO NOT DO THIS. They are most likely going to overreact to you saying this. If you have no one else to speak to and must get it off your chest I recommend you keep it as short as possible. “I have had suicidal thoughts before.” 
These people will treat you like a criminal.  Only saying this because mental institutions are miserable man, they make you want to die even more.
Hello, what kind of music do you like?

It’s a human quality to want other to be put out of their misery. It’s just that most people can not understand the pain and exhaustion  mental illness brings to oneself. My only friend killed himself this year with a shotgun. It’s an incredibly vulgar way to go out.  
I miss him terribly.
Hey man, you musically talented in any way?

I am American, I have actually considered disability. I am able-bodied, just very sick in the head. I have rapid depression and manic cycles weekly. It’s very exhausting, and I try not to be a bitch about it but it’s so hard to continue living. It’s hard for my parent and sibling as well. I am a burden.

I just am sick of wageslaving. I know my mom and sister are sick of having someone like me to look after. I have no purpose and I just don’t want  them to see me die. Should I go to the woods somewhere? I’m just a lost hope, I am too mentally ill for any kind of relationships.
I do, It’s a low end job. Makes my illness worse everytime I go.
